description: Main script for the build process, managing symlinks, invoking `pnpm`-based `tsdown`, and handling build errors and unresolved imports.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within the extensions directory of a specified root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes stale runtime symlinks in the dist and dist-runtime directories.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Analyzes lines of build output to find unresolved import errors outside of known plugin paths.
